title: Tubby's age and how Fred Hall became Tubby
summary: Tubby was two years older, born around 1895; his real name was Fred Hall and he was nicknamed for being fat, with Minor called Little Tubby.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Well do you remember, by the way, when Tubby was born, what year?
Well, let me see. He was, I was two years older than him, and I was born in 97, so I met him. He was born, I don't know what month, but that's your name, born in 95. 95.

Around 95, because I was two years older than him. I don't want to interrupt so much, but while we were talking about Tubby, what was his real name and how did he get that name? His right name was Fred Hall. Oh that's right, Fred.

Fred Hall, yeah. Now where he got this Tubby from, he got so fat. Oh yeah, he was fat when I was born. They quit calling him Babin, they called him Tubby, they used to call him Big Tubby, and they used to call me Little Tubby.
Little Tubby, I never heard that.
